messages:
rachel: Heads up  PartnerBilling flagged a batch of Dedicated invoices where a promotional discount from a pricing experiment was applied to Hosted accounts but not to Dedicated commits. Several customers saw unexpected overage/burst lines.
partner-invoice-bot: Partner invoice import v2 processed for reseller: alpha-partners. Linked invoices: https://partners.redwood.ai/imports/imp-2026-08-12 (auto-note)
dave: Which invoice examples do we have?
rachel: Example: INV-2026-502 (Acadia Health) shows reserved commit $42,000, no promo discount, then OVERAGE_BURST $2,870. The promo should have reduced commit by 20% for qualifying customers during experiment window.
vikram: I pulled the experiment rollout logs. The pricing-experiments service toggled the promo flag for "hosted_only" cohort only. The experiment config should have targeted both hosted and dedicated but the filter used plan_type=="hosted" by mistake.
sylvia: That explains it. Finance needs figure for impacted committed revenue and approvals for retro credits. Likely > $10k for some customers.
billing-bot: Generated query results: 14 dedicated accounts with commit_start between 2026-07-01 and 2026-07-15 that did not receive promo flag. Export: https://billing.redwood.ai/exports/exp-2026-08-12-commits.csv
dave: Can you paste one invoice snippet?
rachel: snippet:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-502
LineItem: RESERVED_COMMIT  Period: 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31  Amount: $42,000  CommitID: rwd-commit-558
LineItem: OVERAGE_BURST   Period: 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-31  Amount: $2,870
```
If the 20% promo had applied to the commit, the commit line would have been $33,600 and the overage might have been smaller due to reduced billable rate in the model used for our chargebacks. So net impact varies by account.
vikram: Engineering remediation: revert experiment, update rule to include plan_type in ["hosted","dedicated"], and run a backfill to flag affected commit records. Backfill ETA: 2026-08-14 02:00Z. Then re-run billing recalc for impacted invoices. Target posts and credits by 2026-08-16.
partner-invoice-bot: Please note reseller alpha-partners will need updated statements. They requested consolidated adjustments.
sylvia: Finance: we need approval to issue retro credits for up to $25k total to resolve this across the 14 accounts. I'll attach per-account estimates once Vikram's backfill completes.
finance-approver: Approve provisional credit authority up to $25k conditioned on engineering PR with backfill plan and a postmortem documenting the misconfiguration. Please include customer communication templates.
dave: Created ticket BLG-3609: "Promo not applied to Dedicated commits during pricing experiment". Assigning to eng-pricing and billing-ops.
billing-bot: Created credit memo batch CM-2026-0400 (placeholder) for estimated $11,420 against affected invoices. Status: pending-post. Reference BLG-3609.
rachel: Once backfill finishes, we'll compute exact credit per invoice, post CMs, update PDFs, and notify partner/reseller + direct account reps. Vikram, can you also run a scan for any SLA-credit interactions? The promo should not affect SLA calc but want to be safe.
vikram: Will run scan during backfill. Also adding an automated test to the experiments service to ensure cohort targeting includes plan types we specify. PR: #pricing-fix-189, target deploy 2026-08-13.
sylvia: Cheers. After credits post, revenue-ops please confirm general ledger entries and update the month-end recognition impact.
revenue-ops (via billing-bot): Noted  awaiting final CM amounts to proceed with journal entries.
finance-approver: Once BLG-3609 has remediation and customer notes, approve final posting. Thanks for the quick triage.
